assessment.value: High-priority lead for a more recent freshwater assessment than the 2013 Tayabas River paper; its reported watershed-scale sampling may cover waterways beyond the named Tayabas River feature.
limitations: The full report is unavailable from the repository record, so methods, tables, station-to-waterbody mapping, taxon identities and references were not independently inspected.
The abstract's reported 12-species total is an aggregate only; it cannot yield a species list or be assigned to Tayabas River, Iyam River, Dumacaa River, or any other individual scope feature.
This historical 2023 project summary does not establish current presence, catchability, natural diet, fishing legality, safety, or complete watershed coverage.
No raw data, abstract table, or species table was copied.
